# PrintLatch

> PrintLatch is an open-source Windows agent for explicitly authorized PDF printing from web and Node.js applications without a print cloud.

## Product facts

- Category: local PDF print bridge for Windows web applications
- Platform: Windows 11 x64
- Input: static, unencrypted PDFs within documented limits
- Authorization: exact-origin browser pairing or local-process authentication
- Queue: durable local job history with conservative retry behavior
- Network boundary: the agent binds to loopback and does not fetch print-job URLs
- License: Apache-2.0

## Primary links

- Product: https://printlatch.vercel.app/
- Source: https://github.com/arturict/printlatch
- Releases: https://github.com/arturict/printlatch/releases
- Documentation: https://github.com/arturict/printlatch/tree/main/docs
